New Zealand v India. Coverage of the fifth and final day of the First Test in the two-match series from Cello Basin Reserve in Wellington. The last time these two sides met in a Test match was in November 2024 as the hosts claimed a 25-run victory in Wankhede, India. That success helped New Zealand to win a third consecutive game in a three-match contest away from home after victories by eight wickets and 113 runs.
